name: Log Calendly bookings from won deals in HubSpot and Google Calendar
description: When a client from your Deals sheet books a date through Calendly, creates the contact and a closed-won deal in HubSpot, adds the engagement to Google Calendar with reminders a week, a day and an hour before, marks the deal as booked in the sheet and sends you a Telegram message. Bookings from anyone who is not a won deal are ignored.
shortDescription: Turn a Calendly booking from a won deal into a HubSpot deal and a Google Calendar event with reminders.
keyFeatures: Only acts when the invitee's email matches a won deal in the Deals tab
Creates the HubSpot contact and a closed-won deal with the agreed amount
Google Calendar event at the booked time with the details, the contact and the price, plus three reminders
Marks the deal booked with the date in the sheet
Telegram notification with what, who, when and how much
Part of a set of five sales templates that share one Google Sheet: prospecting, nurture, negotiation, booking and proposal.
prerequisites: A Deals tab in the same spreadsheet whose header row is: email, name, company, engagement, details, price, status, date; replace REPLACE_WITH_SPREADSHEET_ID with the spreadsheet's ID
HubSpot connection; the deal uses the default pipeline and the closedwon stage
Telegram connection (bot token); replace REPLACE_WITH_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID with the chat that should receive messages
Server public URL configured, so webhooks and the approval links can reach ByteChef
idealFor: Freelancers and small teams who close deals in a spreadsheet and want every booked engagement in their CRM and calendar without copying it by hand.
steps: Trigger: an invitee books an event in Calendly.
Read the Deals tab and loop over the rows.
Continue only for the won deal whose email matches the invitee.
Create the contact and a closed-won deal in HubSpot.
Add the event to Google Calendar with email reminders a week and a day before and a popup an hour before.
Mark the deal booked with the date in the sheet.
Send a Telegram message with the booking.
